title: Xia Brookside vs. Léi Yǐng Lee: friendship broken
summary: Xia Brookside turns on her friend Léi Yǐng Lee, transforming a tag-team bond into a Knockouts championship rivalry. The betrayal eventually brings them together across the ring at Slammiversary.

chapters.title: Brookside betrays Lee
chapters.result: Xia turns against Lee during her match with Arianna Grace.
chapters.context: The intervention helps Grace retain and ends the friendship that had supported Lee’s championship pursuit.

chapters.title: Xia takes her former friend’s title
chapters.result: Brookside defeats Knockouts champion Léi Yǐng Lee.
chapters.context: The former partners meet with the championship now held by Lee. Xia’s victory gives the betrayal a title-winning payoff.
